rationale: Both reviews are well-grounded and highly actionable with concrete file:line refs and code snippets, but the ground-truth concerns center on validation redundancy/consolidation across layers (asukaqaq-s), missing DTO-local invariants (asukaqaq-s's explicit 'unique IDs, positive values' category), and redundant validator calls (RuixiangMa) — Y directly hits all three (findings #2, #7, and the DTO invariant proposal mirrors asukaqaq-s's suggested checks almost verbatim), while X's two findings (missing pre-RPC validation on batch/step paths, silent DLO fallback) only lightly echo the validation-consistency theme. Y also surfaces a genuinely new high-value bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner signature mismatch) and documentation/scope issues echoing hsliuustc0106's stale-description complaint. X is slightly higher precision/tighter (all findings verified real with no overreach), but Y's broader, still well-grounded coverage yields materially better recall without sacrificing much precision.
